research_status: 2014-2020 is disclosed iterative Development; 2021-2023 remains unopened until the Development gate passes
economic_hypothesis: When the broad market is positive and a PIT industry is leading with majority participation, a stock already outperforming within that industry can undergo ordinary profit taking without losing sponsorship. A shallow pullback that preserves rising 20-session support and then makes its first completed reclaim of the 10-session average above the prior bar high is evidence that available supply was absorbed before the next markup attempt.
independence: No downward collapse-gap, V6/V7/V26 event identity, or gap-repair outcome is used.

binding_conditions.PIT_MARKET_AND_LEADING_INDUSTRY: market20 > 0, market breadth20 > 50%, PIT industry20 > 5%, PIT industry breadth20 > 60%, PIT industry60 > 0, and industry20 > market20
binding_conditions.PRIOR_RELATIVE_STRENGTH: stock completed ret20 is between +5% and +35%, and ret60 is between +10% and +60%
binding_conditions.CONTROLLED_SUPPORT_PULLBACK: signal close is 2%-12% below the prior 10-session high; signal low touches no higher than 102% of the prior completed MA10; minimum close in the prior three sessions is at least 97% of the prior completed MA20
binding_conditions.FIRST_MA10_RECLAIM: prior close is below the prior completed MA10; signal close is at or above that MA10 and above the prior bar high; signal return is +0.5% to +6%; close location >=65%; turnover is 0.6x-1.5x prior20 mean

event_cooldown: after an accepted signal identity, the same symbol cannot form another signal for 20 market sessions
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
